```yaml
name: OpenData Commitment Eligibility

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  lint:
    name: PowerShell Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install PowerShell
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y powershell

      - name: Install PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: pwsh -Command "Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser"

      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: pwsh -Command "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Severity Warning,Error | Out-File lint-results.txt"

      - name: Upload lint results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lint-results
          path: lint-results.txt

  unit-tests:
    name: PowerShell Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install PowerShell
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y powershell

      - name: Install Pester
        run: pwsh -Command "Install-Module -Name Pester -Force -Scope CurrentUser"

      - name: Run Pester tests
        run: pwsh -Command "Invoke-Pester -Path .\Tests -OutputFormat NUnitXml -OutputFile TestResults.xml"

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: TestResults.xml

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: ScalableCapital/action-surefire-report@v2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          report_paths: TestResults.xml
          create_check: true
          check_name: Pester Tests
          fail_on_test_failures: true
          fail_if_no_tests: true
```
